sentences.text: Kelly Preston -LRB- born October 13 , 1962 -RRB- is an American actress and former model .

She has appeared in more than sixty television and film productions , most notably including Mischief , Twins and Jerry Maguire .	Mischief	Mischief (film)	Twins	Twins (1988 film)	Jerry Maguire	Jerry Maguire
She is married to John Travolta , with whom she collaborated on the fantasy film Battlefield Earth .	John Travolta	John Travolta	Battlefield Earth	Battlefield Earth (film)
She also starred in the films The Cat in the Hat , Old Dogs , and Broken Bridges .	The Cat in the Hat	The Cat in the Hat (film)	Old Dogs	Old Dogs (film)	Broken Bridges	Broken Bridges
